results.fact: Where the Thumb is relative to Flypaper Pass / Eel Glacier
results.evidence: Still real: baseFinding puts the Thumb short of Flypaper Pass on the Anderson basin side, while the itinerary, timing note and descent cross the Eel Glacier to reach it. A second party's photo caption (taken from ~5,252 ft in the Anderson basin) lists, left to right, the Anderson Glacier, Anderson Thumb, Echo Rock, Flypaper Pass and Mount Anderson, i.e. the Thumb sits WEST of Echo Rock, which matches neither the baseFinding (between Echo Rock and the pass) nor clearly an Eel Glacier crossing. The row's own peak coordinate (47.7159, -123.3418; USGS ground ~6,690 ft) lies north-west of Flypaper Pass, beyond the Eel Glacier bergschrund pin. Peakbagger/ListsOfJohn pages are bot-blocked and no route description exists. What would settle it: a labelled topo or a party's description of how they reached the Thumb's base.

Real: itinerary day 2 schedule[4] says 'fixed anchor/bollard' while descent_text and approach_variants[0].hazards say no fixed hardware. No external source (Mountain Project area page lists only one route on the massif; trip reports and the Wild Outsiders account say nothing about the Thumb's rappel) describes its anchors. What would settle it: any party's account of the Thumb's descent.

results.fact: Total gain in itinerary totalNote vs gain_ft
results.evidence: totalNote says ~6,200 ft while gain_ft/loss_ft and the itinerary day sums say 6,400. No outside source states a car-to-car gain for a Thumb objective; the internal-fix threshold needs one external source, which does not exist. What would settle it: any stated round-trip gain for this Dosewallips/Anderson basin trip.

results.correct_value: gain_ft 6,700 (cumulative car-to-car) is confirmed; itinerary per-day split unsourced
results.evidence: Two independent parties give car-to-car totals from the West Fork Methow trailhead: one 25 mi / 6,700 ft gained and lost via Horse Heaven Camp, another 24 mi / 6,800 ft; a club route page says 'nearly 6,000 ft'. So gain_ft 6,700 and the totalNote are correct as cumulative figures; the itinerary days (1,650 + 4,100 + 0) are net differences that omit the ups and downs. No source gives a per-day split, and rules forbid editing day gainFt values unless totals are sourced per day, so the day rows stay. What would settle it: a per-day gain for the summit day from camp.

results.fact: Gear list offers a 30 m rope the descent calls too short
results.correct_value: optional 60 m rope for the upper-gully rappel
results.evidence: One route page says a 30 m rope will not get you down the final gully by a long shot in early-season snow; an independent club route page says some parties may want a 60 m rope to rappel the upper gully. Both agree on 60 m, matching descent_text; only gear[3]'s '30-60m' disagrees.

Outside totals disagree by line: a Watson-to-Bacon traverse party reported ~10,000 ft over 19 mi from ~3,700 ft, a Bacon Creek party ~9,000 ft, and another Bacon Creek report only the 800-7,061 ft range. No two sources agree on a car-to-car gain for either line. What would settle it: two parties stating round-trip gain for the same approach.
